SASBDB entry SASDVE2  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDVE2/)

Human hemoglobin (Sigma-Aldrich), 5 mg/mL, in 100 mM sodium phosphate pH 7.0 with 10 % (w/v) PEG 2000.
Publication: Baranova I, Angelova A, Stransky J, Andreasson J, Angelov B, Hemoglobin-PEG
Interactions Probed by Small-Angle X-ray Scattering (J Phys Chem B, 2024 Sep 9,
DOI 10.1021/acs.jpcb.4c03003).
Files:
  experimental_data/SASDVE2.dat   SASBDB intensities_files/SASDVE2.dat (q in nm^-1, I in 1/cm)
  SASDV62_fit2_model1.pdb      SASBDB pdb_file/SASDV62_fit2_model1.pdb: the model of the
                               PEG-free control entry SASDV62 (PDB 3ODQ, "identical" per
                               SASBDB; differs from RCSB 3ODQ only in REMARK/REVDAT lines).
                               SASDVE2 itself has no atomic model and no PDB link; no depositor
                               fit curve exists, so there is no .fit file.
The fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDVE2/ states the conditions it takes from the entry;
the paper (PMC11440596) was read on 2026-11-13; see the script header.

Fit range (2026-11-13): the script cuts at q = 0.3 1/A (flat noise floor: above it 174 points, median I/sigma -0.11, 56 % I <= 0).
